title: GroundingPI: A Grounding Foundation Model towards Physical Intelligence with Visual Primitives
abstract: Precise grounding matters. It specifies which object is the target and where that object is, even in clutter and for tiny objects, and it has to be fast enough for closed-loop control. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) take perception from general-purpose vision-language and video-generation backbones, which still fail in these settings. We introduce GroundingPI, a 4B grounding foundation model that generates points and boxes as quantized coordinates in a shared vocabulary. Training combines multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with GRPO, using supervision from public datasets and dedicated data engines. Against 44 baselines across 34 grounding benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, GroundingPI establishes a new state of the art, averaging 73.68%, above the larger GPT-6 Astra (71.54%). As a downstream visual backbone, GroundingPI improves performance on robotic manipulation and autonomous driving. On RoboTwin 2.0, it outperforms every mainstream backbone we evaluate in all four out-of-distribution settings, by up to 24.8% relative to the strongest backbone. On RoboCasa-GR1, GroundingPI trained with 50% of the demonstrations outperforms those baselines trained with 75%. On nuScenes, used as the visual backbone, GroundingPI attains an average open-loop L2 error of 0.296 m. We systematically analyze GroundingPI's pretraining in scale and data composition. Downstream autonomous driving and robotic manipulation improve as the pretraining is scaled. Analyzing the data recipe across these 11 perceptual capabilities shows dense grounding's substantial benefits for both, and OCR's potential as a catalyst for perceptual learning. These results support grounding as a perceptual foundation, and dedicated perceptual pretraining as a promising direction for foundation models of physical intelligence.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In a hypothetical graduate course called Computer Vision and Neural Networks, we would ask how a robot can connect what it sees to what it should do. Today's lecture is on GroundingPI. Recent work such as MolmoAct: Action Reasoning Models that Can Reason in Space and InternVLA-M1 explores ways to bring spatial understanding into robot policies. GroundingPI takes a related but distinct step: it teaches a foundation model to locate targets before an action learner learns how to move. I see your hand, Noah; go ahead.
segments.zh: 在一门假设叫“计算机视觉与神经网络”的研究生课程里，我们会问：机器人如何把看到的东西和它该做的事联系起来。今天的课讲的是GroundingPI。最近的工作，比如MolmoAct：能在空间中推理的动作推理模型，以及InternVLA-M1，探索了把空间理解引入机器人策略的方法。GroundingPI迈出了相关但不同的一步：它先教一个基础模型定位目标，然后才让动作学习器学习怎么移动。诺亚，我看到你举手了，请讲。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, why does locating the target need to be taught separately from learning the action?
segments.zh: 教授您好，为什么定位目标需要和动作学习分开来教呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Because broad visual recognition does not guarantee precise localization. A model might recognize a mug on a cluttered desk yet fail to identify which handle or region matters for a grasp. The desk is the authors’ motivating illustration, not a reported robot trial. Their proposal is to teach the model to point to, or draw a box around, a target first, then use that perception-capable model as a foundation for action learning.
segments.zh: 因为宽泛的视觉识别并不能保证精确定位。模型也许能在一张杂乱的桌子上认出杯子，却无法判断哪个把手或哪块区域对抓取才是关键。桌子只是作者用来引出动机的示例，并不是他们报告的机器人试验。他们的方案是先教模型指向目标，或者在目标周围画一个框，然后再把这个具备感知能力的模型作为动作学习的基础。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So grounding means connecting the instruction to a particular place in the image?
segments.zh: 所以grounding就是把指令和图像中的某个具体位置对应起来？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. Grounding links language to both the object being referred to and its location. GroundingPI has a MoonViT version two visual encoder paired with a Qwen three, four-billion-parameter language decoder. Labels, protocol markers, and 1,000 quantized coordinate tokens share the model’s vocabulary. It can express a box or a point, and it can return “None” when the requested category is absent. That makes location a native output, rather than an external add-on.
segments.zh: 完全正确。Grounding就是把语言与所指的对象及其位置关联起来。GroundingPI采用MoonViT第二版视觉编码器，搭配Qwen3四十亿参数的语言解码器。标签、协议标记和1000个量化坐标token共享模型的词表。它既能输出框，也能输出点，当请求的类别不存在时还能返回“None”。这让位置成为模型的原生输出，而不是外挂的附加功能。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: how does it learn to produce those structured locations reliably?
segments.zh: 快速问一下：它是怎么学会稳定地生成这些结构化位置信息的？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The training recipe has three broad stages: multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement post-training using G-R-P-O. The supervised stage teaches the model the structured response format. In the final stage, rewards encourage coverage and accurate localization; for text recognition, they also reward consistency between the recognized text and its image geometry. The training data combine public datasets with annotations fused and checked by a task-specific data engine.
segments.zh: 训练流程大致分为三个阶段：多模态与空间预训练、监督微调，以及使用G-R-P-O的强化学习后训练。监督阶段教会模型结构化的回答格式。在最后阶段，奖励机制鼓励更全面的覆盖和更准确的定位；对于文字识别，还会奖励识别出的文字与其图像几何结构之间的一致性。训练数据将公开数据集与由任务专用数据引擎融合并校验过的标注结合在一起。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The authors test perception across 34 benchmarks and 11 capabilities. GroundingPI’s reported average is 73.68%, compared with 71.54% for G-P-T six Astra. Read that as an aggregate across unlike tasks, not one universal accuracy score: box grounding and text recognition use an overlap-based F one measure, pointing uses a point-based F one measure, and other tasks use task-specific accuracy. The paper does not specify a weighting formula that would make those tasks directly interchangeable.
segments.zh: 作者在34个基准和11项能力上测试了感知表现。GroundingPI报告的均值是73.68%，相比之下GPT-6 Astra是71.54%。这个数字应理解为跨不同任务的总体汇总，而不是一个通用的准确率分数：框定位和文字识别用的是基于重叠的F1指标，指向任务用的是基于点的F1指标，其他任务则用各自任务特定的准确率。论文没有说明用什么加权公式能让这些任务直接互相换算。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Does that perception lead-board result show that the model will actually help a robot act?
segments.zh: 这个感知排行榜的结果能说明模型真的能帮机器人行动吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That is the more consequential test, and the paper evaluates it with matched downstream training. Within each benchmark, the researchers hold the action expert, action data, training budget, representation, and inference procedure fixed, changing the pretrained foundation. On RoboTwin two point zero Clean2Random, training uses clean demonstrations and testing varies the scene. GroundingPI’s policy reaches 17.60% task success, compared with 14.10% for Rex Omni.
segments.zh: 这才是更有决定性的测试，论文通过匹配的下游训练来评估它。在每个基准中，研究者固定动作专家、动作数据、训练预算、表征和推理流程，只更换预训练基础模型。在RoboTwin 2.0 Clean2Random上，训练使用干净演示，测试则改变场景。GroundingPI的策略达到17.60%的任务成功率，而Rex Omni为14.10%。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can you clarify what changes in those randomized scenes, and how broadly does the advantage hold?
segments.zh: 你能具体说明那些随机化场景里到底变了什么，以及这个优势的适用范围有多广吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The test varies environmental factors such as clutter, lighting, textures, table height, and instructions. GroundingPI leads in all four reported out-of-distribution settings, including tests on RoboTwin and RoboCasa, but it does not lead every manipulation result. For example, RynnBrain reaches 39% on RoboCasa in-distribution, above GroundingPI’s 37.75%. The authors also report a demonstration-efficiency result: using half the demonstrations, GroundingPI reaches 28.75%, above the strongest baseline’s 27.75% using three-quarters.
segments.zh: 测试会改变杂乱程度、光照、纹理、桌面高度和指令等环境因素。GroundingPI在报告的全部四种分布外设置中都领先，包括在RoboTwin和RoboCasa上的测试，但并非每一项操作结果都领先。例如，RynnBrain在RoboCasa分布内达到39%，高于GroundingPI的37.75%。作者还报告了一项演示效率结果：只用一半的演示，GroundingPI达到28.75%，高于最强基线用四分之三演示时的27.75%。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That efficiency claim has a narrow meaning: it concerns robot action demonstrations in this downstream setting, not less pretraining, fewer inference attempts, or shorter elapsed time. The paper also evaluates driving on nuScenes, where GroundingPI’s average open-loop trajectory error is 0.296 meters, compared with 0.301 meters for Qwen three V-L four. This is offline trajectory prediction, not a test of a vehicle controlling itself on the road.
segments.zh: 这个效率声明的含义比较窄：它指的是在这个下游场景中的机器人动作演示，而不是更少的预训练、更少的推理尝试或更短的耗时。论文还在nuScenes上评估了驾驶任务，GroundingPI的平均开环轨迹误差为0.296米，而Qwen three V-L four为0.301米。这是离线轨迹预测，并不是对车辆在道路上自主控制的测试。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: What evidence suggests dense localization, rather than simply more varied training, matters for transfer?
segments.zh: 有什么证据表明，真正对迁移起作用的是密集定位，而不只是训练数据更多样？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The authors remove one training group at a time from a mixture of six groups. Removing dense grounding is associated with a 4.67 percentage-point drop in RoboCasa in-distribution success and a 3.47-point drop in its out-of-distribution average; nuScenes trajectory error also rises by 0.015 meters. Their interpretation is that dense grounding supplies a spatial core. But each group contains many examples and annotations, so this comparison cannot tell us whether object size, clutter, or annotation coverage drives the change.
segments.zh: 作者每次从六个训练组构成的混合数据中移除一个训练组。移除密集定位数据后，RoboCasa分布内成功率下降4.67个百分点，分布外平均成功率下降3.47个百分点；nuScenes轨迹误差也上升了0.015米。他们的解释是，密集定位提供了空间核心。但每个训练组都包含大量样本和标注，因此这一比较无法告诉我们，究竟是物体尺寸、杂乱程度还是标注覆盖率导致了这一变化。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That distinction matters when comparing GroundingPI with related approaches. MolmoAct and InternVLA-M1 also bring spatial representations into robot learning, while GroundingPI emphasizes a shared point-and-box interface and asks whether perception pretraining transfers to action learning. Its matched-backbone results support that possibility, but they do not isolate grounding as the only difference among foundation models. The evidence comes from simulated manipulation and offline driving, not real-world autonomous deployment.
segments.zh: 这一区分在将GroundingPI与相关方法比较时很重要。MolmoAct和InternVLA-M1同样将空间表征引入机器人学习，而GroundingPI强调共享的点和框接口，并追问感知预训练能否迁移到动作学习。其匹配主干的结果支持这一可能性，但并未将grounding孤立为基础模型之间唯一的差异。证据来自模拟操作和离线驾驶，而非真实世界的自主部署。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So the key next step is a more direct test of whether grounding itself causes the improvement?
segments.zh: 所以下一步的关键，是更直接地检验到底是grounding本身带来了改进吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Yes. A stronger causal test could vary grounding supervision while controlling other pretraining differences, and separately probe which kinds of spatial examples matter. For now, the practical implication is more measured: when action demonstrations are limited, teaching a foundation model where relevant objects are may give the action learner a useful starting point. GroundingPI connects explicit localization to better robustness in the tested settings, without showing that perception alone solves robot control.
segments.zh: 是的。更有力的因果检验可以改变接地监督，同时控制其他预训练差异，并分别探究哪些类型的空间示例重要。就目前而言，实际意义更为谨慎：当动作示范有限时，教基础模型相关物体在哪里，可能为动作学习器提供有用的起点。GroundingPI将显式定位与测试环境中更好的鲁棒性联系起来，但并未表明仅靠感知就能解决机器人控制问题。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The memorable takeaway is that a robot may need to know where to act before its action data can teach it how to act. GroundingPI offers evidence for that design direction, especially under the reported distribution shifts, while leaving open which parts of its training recipe produce the gains. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 最值得记住的一点是：机器人可能需要先知道在哪里行动，然后它的动作数据才能教会它如何行动。GroundingPI为这一设计方向提供了证据，尤其是在所报告的分布偏移情况下，但仍未说明其训练方案中哪些部分带来了这些收益。感谢收听。如果你还有任何问题，可以询问我们的AI助手或留言评论。
